parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-application location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The production initializer in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel) and the sample-app copy in package Wallpaper serve different purposes: one is a real framework entry point, the other is a demonstration harness. Consolidating them would couple production DebugPanel semantics to sample-app demonstration code, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
